message.reasoning: We need to parse the problem: "Monday occurred exactly three days ago. Which day of the week comes immediately after today?" So today is some day such that three days ago it was Monday. So if today is X, then X - 3 days = Monday. So X = Monday + 3 days = Thursday. Let's check: If today is Thursday, three days ago (Wednesday, Tuesday, Monday) is Monday. Yes. So today is Thursday. The day immediately after today (i.e., the next day) is Friday. Options: A Saturday, B Friday. So answer B. Need to output only "B".
